DHZ.citation: Deer, Howie & Zussman, An Introduction to the Rock-Forming Minerals, 3rd ed., 2013
DHZ.qualification: Mineral density, hardness, cleavage, optical classes and alteration. Broad project envelopes, not transcribed specimen measurements.

HOM.citation: Anthony et al., Handbook of Mineralogy, Mineral Data Publishing, 1990 onward
HOM.qualification: Mineral species descriptions. Offline bibliographic attribution; numeric endpoints not independently checked in this run.

LEMAITRE.citation: Le Maitre (ed.), Igneous Rocks: A Classification and Glossary of Terms, 2nd ed., 2002
LEMAITRE.qualification: Classification context only. Does not prescribe these mass-mode priors.

BOGGS.citation: Boggs, Principles of Sedimentology and Stratigraphy, 5th ed., 2012
BOGGS.qualification: Sedimentary composition, texture and porosity context.

YARDLEY.citation: Yardley, An Introduction to Metamorphic Petrology, 1989
YARDLEY.qualification: Metamorphic mineral assemblage and fabric context.

GOODMAN.citation: Goodman, Introduction to Rock Mechanics, 2nd ed., 1989
GOODMAN.qualification: Rock mechanical-property scale and variability. Chosen engineering prior endpoints require specimen qualification.

ISRM.citation: ISRM, Suggested Methods for the Quantitative Description of Discontinuities in Rock Masses, 1978
ISRM.qualification: Spacing, persistence, aperture and orientation terminology; site joint populations are not implied.

BIRKELAND.qualification: Weathering pathways and secondary mineral context; no rates inferred.

HAPKE.citation: Hapke, Theory of Reflectance and Emittance Spectroscopy, 2nd ed., 2012
HAPKE.qualification: Particulate transport and grain-size dependence; RGB coefficients here are broad project priors, not spectra.

KM.citation: Kubelka & Munk, Ein Beitrag zur Optik der Farbanstriche, 1931
KM.qualification: Two-flux diffuse half-space R=(1+K/S)-sqrt((1+K/S)^2-1). Intimate mixture used as a reduced model, not a crystalline BRDF solution.

LD.citation: Lekner & Dorf, Why some things are darker when wet, Applied Optics 27, 1278-1280, 1988
LD.qualification: Escape-cone internal reflection mechanism. This implementation is a declared reduced multiple-return model, not a reproduction of all paper terms.

FRESNEL.citation: Born & Wolf, Principles of Optics, 7th ed., 1999

PROJECT.citation: CX-MAT-ROCKSPEC v1, operator brief 2026-10-25 and README.md
PROJECT.qualification: Explicit project prior or model closure. No measured confidence interval. Covariance groups denote constraints, not a fitted covariance matrix.

BRIEF.qualification: Supplied sanity examples basalt 0.05-0.10, granite 0.25-0.35, white marble >=0.6. Not independently verified literature measurements.

RS2.citation: CX-MAT-ROCKSPEC-2 model and conditional priors, 2026-10-25; MODEL_V2.md
RS2.qualification: Explicit uncalibrated physical closures and alternative assemblages; not source-extracted endpoints

RS3.citation: CX-MAT-ASSEMBLAGE 2026-10-25; design review material review F2/F4/F5/F7/F8; MODEL_V3.md
RS3.qualification: Offline recalled mineralogy and engineering ranges; not extracted measurements; no spectral calibration or site admission

RS31.citation: Winter (2010), Principles of Igneous and Metamorphic Petrology, 2nd ed.; Deer, Howie and Zussman (1992), An Introduction to the Rock-Forming Minerals, 2nd ed.; Butt and Zeegers, eds. (1992), Regolith Exploration Geochemistry in Tropical and Subtropical Terrains; MODEL_V3_1.md
RS31.qualification: Offline memory only; broad petrological relationships, no consulted pages or extracted modal/optical numbers. All new numbers are conditional project priors, not setting-wide averages, measurements, or calibration.
